name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clause set correctly captures the task. 'Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once' is exactly Absence(key_lost): the proposition key_lost is defined as dropping the key while door_open is false, so the condition ('while the door is closed') is already built into the event definition, and dropping after the door is open never makes key_lost true — no Precedence is needed. 'Reach the goal' is the hard Existence(at_goal). The machine's FINAL_STATES at u2 and rejecting well at u1 reflect both clauses; the reward model is consistent with a hard Absence break and a hard goal.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
